title: Sirius — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Sirius.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Silent Ventilation." Specialty tier. Sirius makes ultra-quiet range hoods with Australian design sensibility — external motor options for near-silent kitchen ventilation.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Sirius:

• Ultra-quiet operation with external motors

• Australian design heritage

• Premium build quality

• External blower option for near-silent operation

• Clean, minimal design
